data: À trente-trois ans, Mathieu ne sait pas qui est son père. Un matin, un appel téléphonique lui apprend que celui-ci était canadien et qu’il vient de mourir. Découvrant aussi qu’il a deux frères, Mathieu décide d’aller à l’enterrement pour les rencontrer. Mais, à Montréal, personne n’a connaissance de son existence ni ne semble vouloir la connaître… (Thirty-three-year-old Mathieu doesn't know who his father is. One morning, he receives a phone call and discovers that his father was Canadian and has just died. He also learns that he has two brothers. Mathieu decides to go to the funeral to meet them. But in Montreal, no one knows of his existence or seems to want to know him.)

À trente-trois ans, Mathieu ne sait pas qui est son père. Un matin, un appel téléphonique lui apprend que celui-ci était canadien et qu’il vient de mourir. Découvrant aussi qu’il a deux frères, Mathieu décide d’aller à l’enterrement pour les rencontrer. Mais, à Montréal, personne n’a connaissance de son existence ni ne semble vouloir la connaître…

Thirty-three-year-old Mathieu doesn't know who his father is. One morning, he receives a phone call and discovers that his father was Canadian and has just died. He also learns that he has two brothers. Mathieu decides to go to the funeral to meet them. But in Montreal, no one knows of his existence or seems to want to know him.
